name: Headache
summary: Pain or pressure felt in the head or upper neck.
points: Can be dull and constant, or sharp and throbbing
Often triggered by stress, dehydration, or lack of sleep
Sometimes a side effect of medication

name: Nausea
summary: An uneasy, queasy feeling in the stomach, often with an urge to vomit.
points: Can be triggered by certain medications
Also linked to motion sickness, infections, or digestive issues

name: Fatigue
summary: A persistent feeling of tiredness or low energy.
points: Not fully relieved by resting or sleeping
Can be linked to illness or poor sleep
Sometimes a side effect of certain treatments
